name: TryAMM Meetings, Classroom & Broadcast Studio
purpose: Original TryAMM video meeting, classroom, tutoring, webinar, broadcasting and AI-assisted production platform for lessons, businesses, creators, support teams and communities.
positioning: Zoom-style category capabilities plus original AI production and broadcasting tools; do not copy another company's protected branding, assets or proprietary interface.

aiDirector.controlRule: AI may automate low-risk production actions within host-granted permissions; host can override or disable AI Director at any time.

destinations: approved connected external social/video destinations via official APIs
broadcastStudio.externalDistributionRule: Use official APIs/RTMP or approved integrations and respect each destination's terms; never imply universal posting support where a platform does not provide it.

unlimitedPolicy.marketingRule: Do not promise unlimited usage unless infrastructure and fair-use policy truly support it.
unlimitedPolicy.recommendedModel: Offer generous or no hard meeting-count limits on eligible paid plans while metering costly AI, broadcast, recording, storage, egress and premium production usage.

pricingStrategy.principle: Price premium production features above variable infrastructure and AI costs with a configurable target contribution margin; never use a fixed upcharge without measuring actual provider cost.

illustrativePlansNotFinalPrices.Free: basic meetings/classes with constrained duration/capacity and no expensive premium production bundle
illustrativePlansNotFinalPrices.CreatorTeacher: recurring meetings/classes plus a monthly pool of recording/storage and AI assistance
illustrativePlansNotFinalPrices.BroadcastPro: CreatorTeacher plus AI Teleprompter, AI Director, broadcast studio, larger production allowances and premium analytics
illustrativePlansNotFinalPrices.EnterpriseEducation: custom capacity, admin, compliance, support, SSO/white-label options and negotiated usage

pricingStrategy.checkoutRule: Show included allowances, overage/upcharge pricing and estimated variable charges before purchase where practical.
pricingStrategy.marginGate: Finance/AI CostOps must calculate provider cost plus reserves and configured target margin before publishing production prices.

productionDependencies: AI model router and cost metering
